name: TypeScript
summary: TypeScript welcomes AI coding tools, including agents that write an entire patch, as long as the contributor has read and understood the result, can discuss and revise it in review, and discloses the AI use in the pull request description. Bulk, agent-driven contributions and automated comments or auto-generated summaries are never accepted.

evidence.quote: We have no objection to contributors using AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar).

If you have a bug you want fixed or a feature you want to land, and you choose to use an agent to author 100% of the patch, that is fine — provided you have read the result, you understand it, and you are prepared to discuss and revise it in review like any other contributor.
However, we ask that you disclose this in the PR description.
If your PR appears AI-authored and you do not include this disclosure, your PR will be closed without review.

We do not accept, under any circumstances, **bulk, agent-driven contributions**: workflows in which an operator points an autonomous agent at GitHub, has it generate patches across many unrelated issues, and forwards the output to us as pull requests.
Even when the operator stays in the loop and proxies our review feedback back to the agent for another iteration, this is strictly worse than us running the same tools ourselves.
PRs that fit this pattern will be closed with a pointer to this section. Repeated submissions may result in the account being blocked.
**Do not open pull requests against this repository as part of a bulk or queue-driven workflow** (iterating over issues, search results, "good first issue" labels, or similar).

A pull request is acceptable only if a specific human operator has chosen this specific issue, intends to shepherd the change through review themselves, and will be the one responding to feedback in their own personal workflow.
Automated comments (e.g. posting auto-generated PR or issue "summaries") are not allowed and will result in an immediate block for inauthentic activity.
